description: For repositories that generate other projects. Files under a generator's template root are scaffold owned by the project they are generated into, not dependencies of the repository holding them.

packageRules.description: A pinned digest here is baked into every project generated afterwards and cannot be updated without regenerating, so a base-image CVE never reaches them. The floating tag they ship with is picked up on the generated project's next rebuild. Repositories whose template root is elsewhere should extend this list.
